title: cloud: changes_proposed rows carry the label the agent chose for a new object or field (parked per #32984 Q2 B)
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pmEYLVFDcQ1Z1CS8H

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed. Ruling Q2 B 「B 加标签并把格式写进契约」 on #32984 (record 6929142905), parameter 2. Parked per 「应用内搭建 cloud 端不着急改」. ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读

- **是什么：** AI 搭建的修改确认卡上，即将新建的字段现在只显示机器名。云端 agent 发出的 `changes_proposed` 每一行要带上它为对象或字段选定的显示名(label)。
- **配套：** 平台的契约卡(把变更行的格式写进 spec,写错会被拒绝)要先读到这里真实发出的行，所以那张卡等这张卡。
- **暂缓：** 按你的话，云端不着急改。

## Done when

- Every `changes_proposed` row that creates an object or a field carries the label the agent chose. A reading of the keys and verbs cloud really sends today is posted on this card, so the spec card can be written from it.

Dedupe words: changes_proposed label, confirmation card new field name, agent row label.
